How it works

  1. 1
    Match on plan, not profile

    Crews are ranked on area, day, activity, level and budget. There is no photo feed and no swiping. Your age band (25–30) and a public meeting point are the only filters that matter.

  2. 2
    Send one short join message

    The button on each crew writes the intro for you: name, area, level, and the exact plan. Hosts reply with a yes and the meeting point pin.

  3. 3
    Show up, split, leave when you want

    Costs are split on the spot (UPI to the host for court or turf). Most crews end with chai or breakfast, and nobody is expected to stay beyond the plan.

First-meet checklist

  • Meet at the public venue named in the post, never a home address
  • Share the plan and venue with a friend before you go
  • Pay only your split, on the day, to the host at the venue
  • Leave any time. A good crew will not make that awkward

The rules that keep it crew-only

Plans, not people

  • Every post leads with the activity, venue and time
  • No profile photos, no bios, no follower counts
  • Age band is 25–30 so the pace and references match

Public and split-fair

  • Venues are always public: courts, parks, turfs, cafes
  • Costs are stated upfront and split equally on the day
  • No advance payments to strangers, ever

Show up or drop out early

  • Confirm by Friday night so hosts can book the court
  • Two no-shows and hosts can skip your next request
  • Finished the plan? That is a complete, successful meet
